GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (1 Feb 47) LS-R
(SCAPIN - 1502)
APO 500
1 February 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Suspected War Criminals.
The following named Japanese, at present aboard the repatriation ship S.S. "CHORAN MARU", which is due to arrive at SASEBO on or about 1 Feb 47, will be apprehended as a Suspected War Criminal and delivered to the General Staff Officer III (I A), Headquarters, British Commonwealth Occupation Forces at Kure at the earliest possible date.
NAME RANK
KUROKI, Shigenori Sgt
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
